correctness.rationale: The exact EPPF factorization for a marked \(r\)-block shifts the residual partition strength to \(\theta+\alpha\). Exchangeability gives the pair membership probabilities \(r(r-1)/[n(n-1)]\) and \((n-r)(n-r-1)/[n(n-1)]\), proving the covariance with any weighted pair score; summing weights gives a rank-one matrix. The quadratic \(F_n\) has negative value at one, positive value at \(n\), nonpositive value at zero, and positive leading coefficient, so has one positive root in \((1,n)\). The formula, Ewens reduction and asymptotic fraction were reconstructed algebraically. A standalone exact-rational enumeration passed 1,015 comparisons across 35 full laws and four graph families; finite checks are supportive, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: An edge-weighted co-clustering score for an observed graph and the empirical cluster-size frequency vector are natural paired statistics in exchangeable species/partition models. This theorem completely evaluates their finite-sample cross-covariance for every graph and all cluster sizes, characterizes the rank-one interface (all zero-total edge contrasts are orthogonal to the size spectrum), and gives the unique sharply located size threshold separating negative and positive dependence. The explicit Ewens boundary and parameter-dependent asymptotic proportion explain a meaningful nontrivial sign transition; the result is not merely an evaluation of a single marginal moment.
